thread:
monitoring-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU queue depth spike in prod-west-1. queue size from ~820 -> ~2200 in 10m. P95 latency crossing 3s, P99 > 4s. Throttles increasing (429). Affected model: rdlw-model-3.2. Autoscale attempts failing with 'scale limit reached' errors. thread_ts=1829012345
Priya (oncall): paging. i'm oncall — looking now. can someone confirm recent deploys to prod-west-1?
Liam (infra): I saw a rollout earlier for rdlw-model-3.2 around 1829011000. deploy-bot should have notes. suspect config change?
deploy-bot: rollout started: rdlw-model-3.2.0 -> prod-west-1 at 1829011000 by Jun. changelog: default_context=8192, kv_cache=enabled (per-session), kernel-optimizer v2.6.
Jun (mlops): yep that rollout flipped default context/window from 4096 -> 8192 and enabled per-session kv_cache to improve cold-start latency. didn’t expect this much memory per session. investigating.
Alicia (sre-lead): primary hypothesis: per-session kv cache + doubled context increased VRAM per replica -> autoscaler can't provision enough GPUs under current quota/pod-limits -> queue growth -> throttles.
Priya (oncall): can we hot-fix by disabling kv_cache flag for the model or lowering default_context? what's the quickest rollback path?
Liam (infra): checking autoscaler logs now. snippet: ```
E0321 21:10:05 scaler.go:312] error scaling up: quota exceeded for gpu-n1-standard-8, requested 12, available 4
E0321 21:10:06 scaler.go:318] backoff triggered, aborting scale
```
Liam (infra): cloud quota is hit in prod-west-1; warm pool is empty. adding capacity will take ~8-12m for new VMs + provisioning.
Jun (mlops): quick config toggle: we have a runtime flag `kv_cache.enabled` that can be flipped per model without full rollback. it's on by default in 3.2.0. i can push a toggle to staging and then prod if approved.
Priya (oncall): do it. also open rate-limit to reduce new requests? maybe throttle non-enterprise customers to preserve capacity for critical customers.
Sofia (support): standing by to notify impacted customers. initial telemetry shows 18% of tokens are hitting 429s and 23% of requests have latency >2s in the last 12m. no 500s yet.
Carlos (sales-eng): Heads-up: a few larger customers are running high-throughput evals this morning. i'll send a quick ping.
Jun (mlops): pushing config change now: `redwoodctl model-config set rdlw-model-3.2 --kv_cache.enabled=false --context.default=4096` applying to prod-west-1 canary first.
deploy-bot: config apply started on canary nodes (2 replicas). will monitor.
monitoring-bot: canary metrics: queue drop from 2100 -> 700 after toggle, P95 down ~0.9s. continuing rollout to remainder.
Liam (infra): rolling to all nodes. concurrently filing quota increase request with cloud infra; but won't be ready immediately. also enabling emergency warm-pool fill (`infractl warmpool add prod-west-1 8`) to help recovery.
Alicia (sre-lead): mitigation plan: 1) disable kv_cache globally for model (done) 2) lower default_context to 4096 (in the same change) 3) throttle non-SLA customers by 30% (rate-limit policy) 4) request quota increase and add warm pool 5) review rollout gating for model config changes.
Priya (oncall): executed steps 1/2/3. monitoring shows overall queue back to normalish. still watching for secondary hotspots.
Sofia (support): opened incident escalation email to customers flagged as high-traffic. template: "We observed elevated latency / rate limits due to a recent model config rollout; mitigation in progress; will follow up with RCA."
Carlos (sales-eng): thanks — pinged two big eval teams to pause jobs. they confirmed pausing runs.
Jun (mlops): logging the quick revert as hotfix: `hotfix-1829012345-disable-kv` — will create PR to make kv_cache opt-in for future major rollouts.
Alicia (sre-lead): assigning postmortem owner: Jun. oncall handoff at 1829012600 to Liam. include: timeline, root cause, mitigation, customer impact, rollout gating changes.
Priya (oncall): handing off to Liam in 10m. summary for handoff: model 3.2.0 increased context & enabled per-session kv_cache -> VRAM per replica doubled -> autoscaler hit quota -> scale failed -> queue growth -> throttles. hotfix: disabled kv_cache + reduced context, applied rate limits, warmed pool. major customers notified.
Liam (infra): taking over. current action items: verify warm pool spin-up, confirm quota request ticket #INC-8734, and coordinate with supply-side to avoid repeat. i'll own follow-up.
monitoring-bot: :white_check_mark: metrics returning to baseline after 22m. will keep charting for 2h.
Sofia (support): closing customer ping loop once we have the RCA draft.
Jun (mlops): noted for postmortem: add automatic model-config impact estimator (est VRAM per session) to rollout checklist.
Alicia (sre-lead): thanks team. keep comments in this thread for the postmortem. we'll create a dedicated doc and link to INC-8734. (reacted with :eyes:)
Carlos (sales-eng): one follow-up: can we add a per-customer capacity reservation toggle so enterprise customers aren't impacted by global rollouts? adding to backlog.
Priya (oncall): incident status -> mitigated; monitoring until 1829012600 then handoff complete.
